goal: s3armor CI is green on main, every commit identity is Martin <dev@amsys.cz>, and commits are SSH-signed by default in all repos.
scope_fence: No force-push to origin. Remote main is 5 commits behind local and holds no tags, so a normal push suffices.
No change to crypto, format, sigv4 or proxy logic. CI fixes touch dependency pins and test image references only.
No edit to ~/.config/git/config (symlink into mango-dotfiles). config.local is a real untracked file and is in scope.

unknowns.text: What to do with the local tag backup-before-squash (65 commits authored martin@its.mu, not on origin)?
files_set_target has no donation page, FUNDING.yml, sponsor link or <donation> element. What is the reference?
id_ed25519_amsys_sign is passphrase-protected and absent from the running ssh-agent. KeePassXC must load it; that is a GUI step the session cannot do.

success_criteria: git config --global commit.gpgsign is true and gpg.format is ssh
git log --show-signature -1 reports a good signature for dev@amsys.cz
gh run list --limit 1 on the pushed head shows CI success

steps.reason: Untracked local identity file still carries martin@its.mu. ~/.gitconfig currently overrides it, so nothing is broken today, but it is the last live source of the old address.

steps.action: Change the vulnerability-report contact in SECURITY.md to dev@amsys.cz

steps.reason: Global signing default for every repo on the machine. allowedSignersFile already names the dev@amsys.cz key, so verification works once the key is in the agent.
steps.done_check: test "$(git config --global commit.gpgsign)" = true && test "$(git config --global gpg.format)" = ssh

steps.action: Point minio/minio at quay.io/minio/minio and pin tag RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z in both integration tests and both compose files
steps.reason: Docker Hub minio/minio now returns 404 (verified by API probe). quay.io is MinIO's live registry. Pinning a release tag also stops a repeat of this class of break.
steps.done_check: ! grep -rn '"minio/minio"' crates && ! grep -rn 'image: minio/minio' docker-compose.yml docker-compose.e2e.yml

steps.action: cargo update -p rustls to >=0.23.45 to clear RUSTSEC GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc
steps.reason: cargo-deny advisories FAILED on rustls 0.23.43. The advisory names >=0.23.45 as the fix.

steps.action: Run the workspace test suite to confirm the CI failures are gone locally
steps.reason: CI is the only place these two tests ran. Verify before push, not after.
Unpushed commit, so the amend rewrites nothing anyone else has.

steps.action: Rewrite the backup-before-squash tag history to Martin <dev@amsys.cz>
steps.reason: 65 commits reachable only from this local tag still carry martin@its.mu. It is the only thing blocking success criterion 1. Gated because a filter rewrite cannot be undone once the old objects are pruned.

steps.action: Push main to origin (fast-forward, no force)
steps.reason: Publishes to GitHub and starts a CI run. Rule 6 requires an explicit yes for any push.
steps.done_check: git rev-parse HEAD and git rev-parse origin/main match, then gh run list --limit 1
